name: creatomate
description: Creatomate template/render/feed tools with private project profiles and approved exact batches.
long_description: 17 shared tools: 11 reads/helpers and six confirmed operations. V2 template CRUD and rendering, forced free validation, exact ordered paid/status batches and documented V1 compatibility.

token_file.title: Private token-only file
token_file.description: Absolute owner-private token-only project key file; overrides environment key.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide and refuse six paid/template operations. Forced free provider dry runs remain available.

api_key.title: Project API key
api_key.description: Private Creatomate project REST API key, distinct from hosted OAuth.

allow_destructive.title: Allow confirmed mutations
allow_destructive.description: Permit mutation execution only when the tool call explicitly confirms the exact action. Disable to refuse all mutations.
